# Travis Lenkner featured on The Non-Billable Podcast discussing law firm equity investments


- Law firm equity


August 5, 2025


-
-
-
-


Chief Development Officer[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) joins *The Non-Billable Podcast* to discuss why private equity and other external investors are increasingly interested in law firms and what this trend means for Burford Capital.


Listen to the podcast[here](https://www.nonbillable.co.uk/podcasts/travis-lenkner-burford-capital) or read a summary of the interview[here](https://www.nonbillable.co.uk/posts/travis-lenkner-interview) .
